_meta.purpose: Registry of merges that require an operational action (script run, env var set, manual rollout step) AND a verifiable postcondition before they can be considered safely landed. Intended to prevent the 'script exists but was never run' class of mistake.
consumed_by: scripts/ucba-compliance-audit.js (when an operational_action_id is referenced from a UCBA rule)

ci_policies.must_pass: Validator must run AND postcondition must succeed before release
ci_policies.must_verify_before_release: Validator must run; postcondition can be UNVERIFIED if no DB access (e.g. CI without prod creds)

actions.name: Prisma migrations applied to prod before code merge
actions.postcondition_expected: Database schema is up to date
actions.postcondition_description: Vercel build does NOT run migrations (per NEON.md). Migration must be applied manually to prod BEFORE the code that reads new columns merges, otherwise prod will fail with 'column does not exist'.

actions.name: R2 bucket + credentials present before media sync rewrite
actions.postcondition_description: R2 bucket reachable, credentials valid, smoke upload-head-delete cycle succeeds. Required before PR 3 (R2-backed media sync) of the master refactor plan.
actions.notes: Currently running against prod from local. CI version (with R2_* env injected from secrets) deferred to Phase 2 of the validator framework.

actions.name: Twilio SMS configured before SMS-based password reset ships (PR #62)
actions.postcondition_description: Without Twilio env vars set in Vercel Production, the new SMS reset flow silently no-ops. PR #62 must NOT merge until Twilio is confirmed live in production.
actions.verification_method: Check Vercel env via CLI or dashboard; or hit /api/auth/forgot-password in a preview deploy and confirm a real SMS arrives.
